name: dotnetcli.host

schema.title: JSON schema for .NET CLI template host files

description:
The template defines two symbols for use in the generated project. The first symbol, **MyClass**, is visible (its isHidden flag is set to false) and maps to the fully‑qualified type **MyNamespace.MyClass**; its short name remains **MyClass**. The second symbol, **Helper**, is marked as hidden (its isHidden value is the string "true") and corresponds to **Utilities.Helper**, with the short name **Helper**.

Below are a few command‑line snippets that illustrate how you can work with the generated project:

- `dotnet new console -n MyApp` – creates a new console application named **MyApp**.  
- `dotnet build MyApp.csproj` – builds the project file.  
- `dotnet run --project MyApp` – runs the application from the **MyApp** project.
